measures.questionText: ADVISORY VOTE: Should the City proceed with planning and creation of a Troutdale Police Department?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Requires a program, operating by July 2027, in which Portland residents propose projects and make binding choices about funding them. The city must allocate at least the equivalent of 2% of ongoing discretionary General Fund spending, although the council may draw that money from the wider city budget. Staff and residents from all council districts would help develop feasible proposals, with resident oversight and a selection process open to all residents.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Create and fund the resident-led budgeting program under the amended charter.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep the current process in which the mayor proposes a budget and the council reviews and adopts it after public hearings.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Adds a five-year property-tax levy of $1.60 per $1,000 of assessed value for police, fire and 911 services, from 2027–28 through 2031–32. The official summary says the current council will replace the $25 monthly public-safety fee with this levy. For a home assessed at $267,800, it estimates $428.48 a year in levy taxes and a net annual increase of $128.48 after removing the $300 annual fee. The levy may increase property taxes by more than 3%.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the five-year property-tax levy for police, fire and 911 services.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not authorize this five-year property-tax levy.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Asks whether Troutdale should continue planning and creating its own police department while comparing that option with continued service from the Multnomah County Sheriff. The vote is advisory and does not authorize taxes, fees or spending; the council will consider the result in later decisions.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Advise the council to proceed with planning and creation of a city police department.
measureRecords.noMeans: Advise the council against proceeding with the proposed city police department.
